+    def get_domain(rule: t.Any) -> str:
+        """Calculate the full domain from host, subdomain, and server_name."""
+        # If the rule has an explicit host, use it
+        if rule.host:
+            return rule.host
+        
+        # Otherwise, use subdomain + server_name
+        if server_name:
+            if rule.subdomain:

+    def test_subdomain(self, runner):
+        """Test that routes with subdomains show the correct domain."""
+        def create_app():
+            app = Flask(__name__)
+            app.config["SERVER_NAME"] = "test.local"
+            app.testing = True
+
+            admin_bp = Blueprint("admin", __name__)
+            test_bp = Blueprint("test", __name__)
+
+            @admin_bp.route("/home")
+            def admin_home():
+                pass
+
+            @test_bp.route("/home")
+            def test_home():
+                pass
+
+            app.register_blueprint(admin_bp, url_prefix="", subdomain="admin")
+            app.register_blueprint(test_bp, url_prefix="", subdomain="test")
+
+            return app
+
+        cli = FlaskGroup(create_app=create_app)
+        result = runner.invoke(cli, ["routes"])
+        assert result.exit_code == 0
+        # Check that the domain column is present
+        assert "Domain" in result.output
+        # Check that the subdomains are shown with the server name
+        assert "admin.test.local" in result.output
+        assert "test.test.local" in result.output
+        assert "test.local" in result.output  # static route
+
+    def test_host(self, runner):
+        """Test that routes with host parameters show the correct domain."""
+        def create_app():
+            app = Flask(__name__, static_folder=None)
+            app.testing = True
+
+            @app.route("/api", host="api.example.com")
+            def api_host():
+                pass
+
+            @app.route("/www", host="www.example.com")
+            def www_host():
+                pass
+
+            return app
+
+        cli = FlaskGroup(create_app=create_app)
+        result = runner.invoke(cli, ["routes"])
+        assert result.exit_code == 0
+        # Check that the domain column is present

+        # Check that the hosts are shown
+        assert "api.example.com" in result.output
+        assert "www.example.com" in result.output
